text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day leading up to the Japanese Derby, 
the contender Umamusume gathered together, 
each sharing their thoughts and 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In such a setting, however, only Grass 
Wonder offers calm, measured, and harmless 
remarks compared to the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, El Condor Pasa showed up to 
throw down the gauntlet to Grass Wonder, 
who hadn't revealed her true feelings 
during the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder quietly stoked her fighting 
spirit heading toward the Nippon Derby.
